text.pages_rule: 12n-1 supply (12n-1); packed 184 content pages, guide p.5 suggests 191 -- blank padding not supplied at the owner's request
text.page_fit_note: master 209.9 x 269.9 mm is smaller than the 216 x 279 mm trim and its edges carry detail (worst step 78/255). Enlarging it to reach the cut would push its text out of the 20 mm gutter, so the page is placed 1:1: the outer 3.06 mm (sides) and 4.54 mm (top and bottom) of the printed page carry a soft continuation of the page edge. Re-export this master at 216 x 279 mm to remove it
text.content_shift_note: content moved 5.7 mm toward the outer edge and 0.0 mm down: closest live text is now 21.0 mm off the gutter (was 15.3), 13.4 mm from the outer trim (was 19.1) and 14.2 mm from the top trim (their rules: 20 mm gutter, 5 mm trim; tightest page 182, 12.2 mm off the gutter)
text.note: kept RGB: 128 Type 3 fonts block Ghostscript's CMYK conversion (guide p.6 accepts RGB, their preflight converts); transparency left on 176 pages (the flattening pass could not clear it)

checks.name: Text file page size is 222 x 285 mm
checks.detail: 222.00 x 285.00 mm = 216 x 279 mm trim plus 3 mm bleed (their text template is 222 x 285)

checks.name: Bleed is 3 mm on all four edges
checks.detail: guide p.5 requires 3 mm; media extends 3 mm past the trim on every side

checks.name: Bleed continues the page edge
checks.detail: no point across the cut lines puts a whitish colour against a coloured one (6624 points checked), so no white nick can print

checks.name: Bleed approximates the artwork at the cut
checks.detail: 7 of 6624 points differ by more than 30 units where both sides are coloured detail: the flat smear's limit on artwork that runs along the cut, entirely inside the 3 mm that is trimmed away

checks.name: Page artwork survives assembly
checks.detail: page 64: content 41.7% ink against 57.2% in the master

checks.name: Bleed seam matches the artwork
checks.detail: -- a flat bleed can only approximate artwork whose colour runs along the cut as a steep gradient; the page inside the trim is unaffected

checks.name: Live text clears their 20 mm gutter
checks.detail: closest live text is 21.0 mm off the gutter (page 182); guide p.3 asks for 20 mm

checks.name: Live text clears their 5 mm trim safety
checks.detail: closest live text is 10.8 mm from the bottom edge (page 172); their template draws a 5 mm safety line

checks.name: Single pages, portrait
checks.detail: 184 single pages, portrait, all 222.0 mm wide

checks.name: Page count is 12n-1
checks.detail: 184 pages (184 of book); guide p.5: supply one less than a divisible of 12, the production barcode is added to the last page

checks.name: Last page is clear for their barcode
checks.detail: the final page is blank, so the barcode they add lands on nothing

checks.name: Cover pages stripped from the interior
checks.detail: the front cover and the back cover are removed: they belong in the cover file, and leaving them in prints the cover twice

checks.name: All fonts embedded
checks.detail: every font is embedded (guide p.3)

checks.name: No Type 3 glyph-program fonts
checks.detail: 128 Type 3 fonts. These carry headings as drawing programs instead of an embedded font, so preflight rates them lowest of all font types, and Ghostscript 10.02.1 segfaults converting them to CMYK -- this book therefore stays RGB, which BookVault accept and convert themselves

checks.name: Transparency flattened
checks.detail: 176 pages still carry it (page 2: transparency group); Ghostscript's flattening pass ran and left it in place, so it has to be cleared before a print run (guide p.3)

checks.name: Images at 300 DPI or better
checks.detail: 121 below 300 DPI, e.g. page 2: 150 DPI; page 3: 150 DPI; page 3: 150 DPI

checks.name: Master page box fitted to their trim
checks.detail: master 209.9 x 269.9 mm is smaller than the 216 x 279 mm trim and its edges carry detail (worst step 78/255). Enlarging it to reach the cut would push its text out of the 20 mm gutter, so the page is placed 1:1: the outer 3.06 mm (sides) and 4.54 mm (top and bottom) of the printed page carry a soft continuation of the page edge. Re-export this master at 216 x 279 mm to remove it

checks.name: Artwork covers the printed area
checks.detail: the artwork reaches 0.2 mm past the 216 x 279 mm trim on every visible edge; at the gutter, where the page gives way to reach their 20 mm rule, the fill sits 5.8 mm inside the trim -- within the binding zone and the page's own edge colour

checks.name: Binding-edge clearance
checks.detail: closest text is 24.8 mm from the left edge on page 31; guide p.3 asks for 20 mm on the gutter, their template prints 17 mm

checks.name: No trim or bleed marks
checks.detail: none are drawn, and the media box is exactly trim + bleed (222.00 x 285.00 mm), leaving no room for any

checks.name: Text file is PDF/X-1a:2001 with CMYK
checks.detail: kept RGB: 128 Type 3 fonts block Ghostscript's CMYK conversion (guide p.6 accepts RGB, their preflight converts); transparency left on 176 pages (the flattening pass could not clear it)

checks.name: Cover file is a perfect-bound spread
checks.detail: 448.99 x 284.99 mm = back 216 + spine 11 + front 216 + 3 mm bleed, by their p.18 formula

checks.name: Barcode area clear on the back cover
checks.detail: the 38 x 25 mm box their template reserves (6.4 mm in from the right trim, 3.3 mm up) is 51.2% covered by artwork; a barcode is required printing outside the UK

checks.name: Spine width taken from their sizing calculator
checks.detail: built at 11 mm from 184 pages x 0.056 mm per page, rounded up (guide p.18). Run home > help > sizing calculator for the real paper and rebuild with --spine-mm <mm>
